description: This file is a C source code file implementing a utility to sign firmware images by appending a signature structure with device ID, firmware version, and CRC32 checksum, including functions for CRC calculation and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: chksum_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum of a file using a precomputed CRC table.

methods.name: chksum_crc32gentab
methods.description: Generates the CRC32 lookup table used for checksum calculation.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line utility.
